_comment_templateDeviations: OPC 20020 admits no deviation. A relaxation is therefore only legitimate when it is declared here, printed in the document, and matched by the validator; validate_docx refuses to relax a check whose statement it cannot find in the produced document, and refuses a deviation it does not know.

templateDeviations.statement: This document defines a JSON-LD vocabulary and a mapping between OPC UA NodeSet2 files and W3C Web of Things documents. It defines no OPC UA information model of its own: it has no NodeSet, no ObjectTypes, no VariableTypes, no DataTypes, no ReferenceTypes and no Instances. The NodeClass clauses of OPC 20020 are therefore omitted rather than left empty, and Annex A states the machine-readable artifacts this document does define — the JSON-LD context and the JSON Schema — in place of a NodeSet.

identity.title: WoT Binding
identity.subTitle: Part 1: JSON-LD vocabulary and NodeSet2 mapping
identity.otherOrganization: W3C Web of Things Working Group
introduction: The W3C Web of Things (WoT) describes a device or a service by a Thing Description: a JSON-LD document that names its properties, actions and events and states which protocol operation reads, writes, observes or invokes each of them. A Thing Model is the reusable, instance-independent template a Thing Description is derived from. Which protocol an affordance actually speaks is supplied by a binding: a vocabulary that maps the abstract operations onto one concrete protocol.

This document is that binding for OPC UA. It defines the JSON-LD vocabulary bound to the prefix uav, with which a Thing Description addresses OPC UA Nodes, expresses the Read, Write, Observe and Call operations as OPC UA Services, and carries the parts of an address space — NodeClasses, Attributes, References and modelling rules — that a Thing Description otherwise has no way to say.

Because the vocabulary covers the address space and not only the protocol, it is also a conversion format: a NodeSet2 file can be expressed as a Thing Model or Thing Description and recovered from it, with the exceptional cases that a semantic mapping cannot reach carried in an explicit, verifiable envelope.
